name: Redis Cache
label: Redis Cache — generic key/value and lists
description: Generic Redis cache node (RESP2). Operations: SET, GET, DEL, LPUSH, RPUSH, LRANGE, LTRIM, EXPIRE against a customer-owned Redis. Wire this to an AI Agent memory FUNCTION port — the agent emits RPUSH/LRANGE/LTRIM/DEL with key sq:memory:<scoped-conversation-id> and JSON message values, diff-syncing across runs. Not a queue (see Queue) and not a vector store. Password and redis(s):// URL stay in configurationParameters and are never logged. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One cache operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example: {"operation":"RPUSH","key":"sq:memory:9f1c…","value":{"role":"user","content":"hi"}}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Cache verb. Purpose: overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values (case-insensitive): SET (write string/JSON) | GET (read string or nil) | DEL (delete key) | LPUSH (prepend to list) | RPUSH (append to list) | LRANGE (read list slice) | LTRIM (trim list) | EXPIRE (set TTL). Any other token fails with error and does not talk to Redis. Example: 'RPUSH'. Example read: 'LRANGE'.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Redis key. Purpose: names the string or list. REQUIRED. Empty/whitespace fails with 'key is required' (no command is sent). Accepted value: non-empty UTF-8 string. AI Agent memory uses 'sq:memory:<uuid>'. Example: 'sq:memory:9f1c6d2e-4a11-4b22-8c33-77aa00bbcc11'. Example session: 'user:42:prefs'.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Payload for SET / LPUSH / RPUSH. Purpose: stored as a Redis string. Accepted values: string (stored as-is), number/boolean (String.valueOf), object/array (JSON). Null/omit → empty string. Do not put secrets here. Example object: {"role":"user","content":"hi"}. Example string: 'ok'.

schema.label: start
schema.description: Inclusive index for LRANGE / LTRIM. Purpose: Redis list window. Accepted values: integers (negative = from tail). Default 0. Example: 0. Example last 10: start=-10 with stop=-1.

schema.label: stop
schema.description: Inclusive end index for LRANGE / LTRIM. Purpose: Redis list window. Accepted values: integers. Default -1 (last element). Example: -1.

schema.label: ttl_seconds
schema.description: Optional TTL applied after SET/LPUSH/RPUSH, or the seconds for EXPIRE. Purpose: expire the key. Accepted values: integers ≥ 1. 0 / omit / negative → no EXPIRE. Example: 86400.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', data:{value}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Success payload. Purpose: data.value is the GET string, LRANGE list, SET/PUSH status or integer, or null on GET miss. Never includes secrets. Example LRANGE: {"value":["{\"role\":\"user\"}"]}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank. Purpose: instance default. EXACT accepted values: SET | GET | DEL | LPUSH | RPUSH | LRANGE | LTRIM | EXPIRE. Required. Example: 'LRANGE'.

configurationParameters.label: Url
configurationParameters.description: Optional redis:// or rediss:// URL. Purpose: host/port/db/password in one field. Accepted schemes: redis (plain TCP), rediss (TLS). May embed :password@ — treat as secret. When set, host/port/db are taken from the URL. Blank → use host/port/db fields. Example: 'rediss://:s3cret@cache.internal:6379/0'.

configurationParameters.label: Host
configurationParameters.description: Redis hostname or IPv4/IPv6. Purpose: used when url is blank. Accepted value: non-empty host. Default 127.0.0.1. Customer owns this endpoint. Example: '127.0.0.1'. Example: 'redis.prod.svc'.

configurationParameters.label: Port
configurationParameters.description: Redis TCP port when url is blank. Purpose: connect target. Accepted values: positive integers. Default 6379. ≤0 → 6379. Example: 6379.

configurationParameters.label: Db
configurationParameters.description: Redis logical database index (SELECT). Purpose: isolate keys. Accepted values: integers ≥ 0. Default 0. Overridden by /N on the URL path. Example: 0.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: AUTH password. Purpose: sent as AUTH <password> after connect when non-blank. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT, never logged, never returned. URL userinfo password is used when this is blank. Example: bind a secret reference, not a literal.

configurationParameters.label: Ttl Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Default TTL applied after SET/LPUSH/RPUSH when input.ttl_seconds is not a positive integer. Purpose: expire keys. Accepted values: integers ≥ 1. 0 / blank → no default TTL. Example: 86400.

configurationParameters.label: Verify Tls
configurationParameters.description: TLS certificate check for rediss://. Purpose: default true (HTTPS endpoint identification). EXACT accepted values: 'true' (verify) | 'false' (lab-only trust-all). Any other/blank → true. Never disable in production. Example: 'true'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read budget in seconds. Purpose: bound a hung Redis. Accepted values: positive integers. Blank/0/negative → 25. Capped at 60 so the invoke stays under the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
